title: DeepSeek Harness Sidebar Embed
description: 把 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 嵌入 VS Code 右侧（辅助）边栏：工作区可复用当前打开的文件夹或新建文件夹，会话与 dsh web 实时同步。

title: InfraPilot - Terraform/OpenTofu Plan Viewer & Ansible Vault
description: Run Terraform and OpenTofu plans as a clear color-coded list, and open Ansible Vault files without leaving the editor. Free tier included; Pro unlocks attribute diffs, apply, state browser and in-place vault editing.

title: Greedcon
description: Professional API testing and development platform for VS Code. Build, send and inspect HTTP requests, manage collections, environments and automated tests — all locally.

title: Git Helm
description: Keyboard-driven git client for VS Code: status buffer, log graph, staging, diffs, stash, rebase and worktrees — GitSavvy-style, one screen per task.

title: Mini Pomodoro
description: A visible Pomodoro countdown in the VS Code status bar, with start and pause controls.

title: Datifique
description: A Nuvem da Datifique no editor: os arquivos do projeto, o que chegou do celular, e a IA que organiza.

title: Buildkite Pipeline Explorer
description: Securely browse and trigger authorized Buildkite pipelines.

title: Port Manager Dashboard
description: Live sidebar of listening ports: what holds each one, its CPU and memory, and one-click Stop. Click an EADDRINUSE error in the terminal to free its port.
